name: The Game of Death
source:
I took revenge, turned myself in, and didn’t resist. They sentenced me to death. But this prison has its own rules – death row isn’t the end.

Every year, a violent spectacle is held, where prisoners can fight for their freedom. It’s voluntary, open to all – and nearly impossible to win.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
我报了仇，自首，没有反抗。他们判处我死刑。但这所监狱有它自己的规则——死囚牢房并不是终点。

每年都会举行暴力场面，囚犯可以为自由而战。它是自愿的，向所有人开放——而且几乎不可能获胜。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
